name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)
summary: Join at age 18–40 and contribute; assured pension of ₹3,000 a month from age 60.
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for old-age protection and social security of unorganised workers.
implementingAuthority: Ministry of Labour & Employment (enrolment through Common Service Centres)

criteria.label: Your monthly income is up to Rs 15,000 (this is personal monthly income, not annual family income)

benefits.text: Assured pension of Rs. 3000 per month from age 60, with a matching contribution by the Government of India.

evidence.quote: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana provides assured 3000 monthly pension to Unorganised workers at age of 60 years.

applicationProcess: Enrol through the Maandhan portal or at a Common Service Centre (CSC).

sources.title: MAANDHAN - Pension for Unorganised Labour (home page)

warnings: Exclusion conditions in the PM-SYM FAQ (for example EPFO/ESIC/NPS membership) were not captured because maandhan.in/shramyogi returned HTTP 404. Confirm them on the official portal.

provenance.reviewer: Mera Haq data curation (Claude Code session, 2026-11-06)
